title_zh: 同一普通任务的普通—验证—故障—恢复四态旅程
title_en: Ordinary–proof–failure–recovery journey for one ordinary task

presentation.timing_meaning: Interface pacing only: 12 seconds per state and 48 seconds total are not real failure, restoration or recovery durations.
presentation.static_fallback: All four bilingual state cards remain visible and complete without JavaScript.
presentation.reduced_motion: Timing is disabled; the primary control advances one discrete state at a time.

invariant.zh: 连续日常轨与非 AI 完整路径在四态中始终可用；动态只解释旁侧验证叠层。
invariant.en: The continuous civic track and complete non-AI path remain available in every state; motion explains only the side proof overlay.

states.public_condition: Screen-free information, staffed service, accessible-intent route, bypass and exit remain available; proof is off.
The proof overlay is voluntary, announced, bounded and accountable; a same-task non-AI control remains beside it.
Automation stops before interface reassurance; staffed takeover, isolation, bypass, inquiry and exit preserve the ordinary task.
Restore the ordinary route and service first. Proof remains G0, paused or retired unless the evidence gate closes.

reality_guard.claim: This interaction is an explanatory review layer, not site evidence, an operating result, an approval or a construction promise.
